verses.en: And the second lot came forth to Simeon, even for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families: and their inheritance was within the inheritance of the children of Judah.
verses.pt: A segunda porção saiu para Simeão, pela tribo dos filhos de Simeão conforme suas famílias; e sua herança foi entre a herança dos filhos de Judá.
verses.en_web: The second lot came out for Simeon, even for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families. Their inheritance was in the middle of the inheritance of the children of Judah.
verses.en_bbe: And the second heritage came out for the tribe of Simeon by their families; and their heritage was in the middle of the heritage of the children of Judah.

verses.en: And they had in their inheritance Beer-sheba, or Sheba, and Moladah,
verses.pt: E tiveram em sua herdade a Berseba, Seba, e Moladá,
verses.en_web: They had for their inheritance Beersheba (or Sheba), Moladah,
verses.en_bbe: And they had for their heritage Beer-sheba and Shema and Moladah

verses.en: And Hazar-shual, and Balah, and Azem,
verses.pt: Hazar-Sual, Balá, e Azem,
verses.en_web: Hazar Shual, Balah, Ezem,
verses.en_bbe: And Hazar-shual and Balah and Ezem

verses.en: And Eltolad, and Bethul, and Hormah,
verses.pt: Eltolade, Betul, e Hormá,
verses.en_web: Eltolad, Bethul, Hormah,
verses.en_bbe: And Eltolad and Bethul and Hormah

verses.en: And Ziklag, and Beth-marcaboth, and Hazar-susah,
verses.pt: Ziclague, Bete-Marcabote, e Hazar-Susa,
verses.en_web: Ziklag, Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susah,
verses.en_bbe: And Ziklag and Beth-marcaboth and Hazar-susah

verses.en: And Beth-lebaoth, and Sharuhen; thirteen cities and their villages:
verses.pt: Bete-Lebaote, e Saruém; treze cidades com suas aldeias:
verses.en_web: Beth Lebaoth, and Sharuhen; thirteen cities with their villages;
verses.en_bbe: And Beth-lebaoth and Sharuhen; thirteen towns with their unwalled places;

verses.en: Ain, Remmon, and Ether, and Ashan; four cities and their villages:
verses.pt: Aim, Rimom, Eter, e Asã; quatro cidades com suas aldeias:
verses.en_web: Ain, Rimmon, Ether, and Ashan; four cities with their villages;
verses.en_bbe: Ain, Rimmon, and Ether and Ashan; four towns with their unwalled places;

verses.en: And all the villages that were round about these cities to Baalath-beer, Ramath of the south. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families.
verses.pt: E todas as aldeias que estavam ao redor destas cidades até Baalate-Beer, que é Ramá do sul. Esta é a herança da tribo dos filhos de Simeão, segundo suas famílias.
verses.en_web: and all the villages that were around these cities to Baalath Beer, Ramah of the South. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families.
verses.en_bbe: And all the unwalled places round about these towns as far as Baalath-beer-ramah to the south. This is the heritage of the tribe of Simeon by their families.

verses.en: Out of the portion of the children of Judah was the inheritance of the children of Simeon: for the part of the children of Judah was too much for them: therefore the children of Simeon had their inheritance within the inheritance of them.
verses.pt: Da porção dos filhos de Judá foi tirada a herança dos filhos de Simeão; porquanto a parte dos filhos de Judá era escessiva para eles: assim que os filhos de Simeão tiveram sua herança em meio da deles.
verses.en_web: Out of the part of the children of Judah was the inheritance of the children of Simeon; for the portion of the children of Judah was too much for them. Therefore the children of Simeon had inheritance in the middle of their inheritance.
verses.en_bbe: The heritage of Simeon was taken out of Judah's stretch of land, for Judah's part was more than they had need of, so the heritage of the children of Simeon was inside their heritage.

verses.en: And the third lot came up for the children of Zebulun according to their families: and the border of their inheritance was unto Sarid:
verses.pt: A terceira porção saiu pelos filhos de Zebulom conforme suas famílias: e o termo de sua herança foi até Saride.
verses.en_web: The third lot came up for the children of Zebulun according to their families. The border of their inheritance was to Sarid.
verses.en_bbe: And the third heritage came out for Zebulun by their families; the limit of their heritage was as far as Sarid;

verses.en: And their border went up toward the sea, and Maralah, and reached to Dabbasheth, and reached to the river that is before Jokneam;
verses.pt: E seu termo sobe até o mar e até Maralá, e chega até Dabesete, e dali chega ao ribeiro que está diante de Jocneão.
verses.en_web: Their border went up westward, even to Maralah, and reached to Dabbesheth. It reached to the brook that is before Jokneam.
verses.en_bbe: And their limit goes up to the west to Maralah, stretching to Dabbesheth, and to the stream in front of Jokneam;

verses.en: And turned from Sarid eastward toward the sunrising unto the border of Chisloth-tabor, and then goeth out to daberath, and goeth up to Japhia,
verses.pt: E tornando de Saride até oriente, o oriente ao termo de Quislote-Tabor, sai a Daberate, e sobe a Jafia;
verses.en_web: It turned from Sarid eastward toward the sunrise to the border of Chisloth Tabor. It went out to Daberath, and went up to Japhia.
verses.en_bbe: Then turning east from Sarid to the limit of Chisloth-tabor, it goes out to Daberath, and up to Japhia;

verses.en: And from thence passeth on along on the east to Gittah-hepher, to Ittah-kazin, and goeth out to Remmon-methoar to Neah;
verses.pt: E passando dali até o lado oriental a Gate-Hefer e a Ete-Cazim, sai a Rimom rodeando a Neá;
verses.en_web: From there it passed along eastward to Gath Hepher, to Ethkazin; and it went out at Rimmon which stretches to Neah.
verses.en_bbe: And from there it goes on east to Gath-hepher, to Eth-kazin; ending at Rimmon which goes as far as Neah;

verses.en: And the border compasseth it on the north side to Hannathon: and the outgoings thereof are in the valley of Jiphthah-el:
verses.pt: E daqui torna este termo ao norte a Hanatom, vindo a sair ao vale de Iftá-El;
verses.en_web: The border turned around it on the north to Hannathon; and it ended at the valley of Iphtah El;
verses.en_bbe: And the line goes round it on the north to Hannathon, ending at the valley of Iphtah-el;

verses.en: And Kattath, and Nahallal, and Shimron, and Idalah, and Bethlehem: twelve cities with their villages.
verses.pt: E engloba Catate, e Naalal, e Sinrom, e Idala, e Belém; doze cidades com suas aldeias.
verses.en_web: Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah, and Bethlehem: twelve cities with their villages.
verses.en_bbe: And Kattath and Nahalal and Shimron and Idalah and Beth-lehem; twelve towns with their unwalled places.

verses.en: This is the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families, these cities with their villages.
verses.pt: Esta é a herdade dos filhos de Zebulom por suas famílias; estas cidades com suas aldeias.
verses.en_web: This is the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families, these cities with their villages.
verses.en_bbe: This is the heritage of the children of Zebulun by their families, these towns with their unwalled places.

verses.en: And the fourth lot came out to Issachar, for the children of Issachar according to their families.
verses.pt: A quarta porção saiu para Issacar, pelos filhos de Issacar conforme suas famílias.
verses.en_web: The fourth lot came out for Issachar, even for the children of Issachar according to their families.
verses.en_bbe: For Issachar the fourth heritage came out, for the children of Issachar by their families;

verses.en: And their border was toward Jezreel, and Chesulloth, and Shunem,
verses.pt: E foi seu termo Jezreel, e Quesulote, e Suném,
verses.en_web: Their border was to Jezreel, Chesulloth, Shunem,
verses.en_bbe: And their limit was to Jezreel and Chesulloth and Shunem

verses.en: And Haphraim, and Shihon, and Anaharath,
verses.pt: E Hafaraim, e Siom, e Anaarate,
verses.en_web: Hapharaim, Shion, Anaharath,
verses.en_bbe: And Hapharaim and Shion and Anaharath

verses.en: And Rabbith, and Kishion, and Abez,
verses.pt: E Rabite, e Quisiom, e Ebes,
verses.en_web: Rabbith, Kishion, Ebez,
verses.en_bbe: And Rabbith and Kishion and Ebez

verses.en: And Remeth, and En-gannim, and En-haddah, and Beth-pazzez;
verses.pt: E Remete, e En-Ganim, e En-Hadá e Bete-Pazez;
verses.en_web: Remeth, Engannim, En Haddah, and Beth Pazzez.
verses.en_bbe: And Remeth and En-gannim and En-haddah and Beth-pazzez;

verses.en: And the coast reacheth to Tabor, and Shahazimah, and Beth-shemesh; and the outgoings of their border were at Jordan: sixteen cities with their villages.
verses.pt: E chega este termo até Tabor, e Saazima, e Bete-Semes; e sai seu termo ao Jordão: dezesseis cidades com suas aldeias.
verses.en_web: The border reached to Tabor, Shahazumah, and Beth Shemesh. Their border ended at the Jordan: sixteen cities with their villages.
verses.en_bbe: And their limit goes as far as Tabor and Shahazimah and Beth-shemesh, ending at Jordan; sixteen towns with their unwalled places.

verses.en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Issachar according to their families, the cities and their villages.
verses.pt: Esta é a herança da tribo dos filhos de Issacar conforme suas famílias; estas cidades com suas aldeias.
verses.en_web: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Issachar according to their families, the cities with their villages.
verses.en_bbe: This is the heritage of the tribe of the children of Issachar by their families, these towns with their unwalled places.

verses.en: And the fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families.
verses.pt: E saiu a quinta porção pela tribo dos filhos de Aser por suas famílias.
verses.en_web: The fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families.
verses.en_bbe: And the fifth heritage came out for the tribe of Asher by their families.

verses.en: And their border was Helkath, and Hali, and Beten, and Achshaph,
verses.pt: E seu termo foi Helcate, e Hali, e Béten, e Acsafe,
verses.en_web: Their border was Helkath, Hali, Beten, Achshaph,
verses.en_bbe: And their limit was Helkath and Hali and Beten and Achshaph

verses.en: And Alammelech, and Amad, and Misheal; and reacheth to Carmel westward, and to Shihor-libnath;
verses.pt: E Alameleque, e Amade, e Misal; e chega até Carmelo ao ocidente, e a Sior-Libnate;
verses.en_web: Allammelech, Amad, Mishal. It reached to Carmel westward, and to Shihorlibnath.
verses.en_bbe: And Alammelech and Amad and Mishal, stretching to Carmel on the west and Shihor-libnath;

verses.en: And turneth toward the sunrising to Beth-dagon, and reacheth to Zebulun, and to the valley of Jiphthah-el toward the north side of Beth-emek, and Neiel, and goeth out to Cabul on the left hand,
verses.pt: E tornando do oriente a Bete-Dagom, chega a Zebulom, e ao vale de Iftá-El ao norte, a Bete-Emeque, e a Neiel, e sai a Cabul à esquerda;
verses.en_web: It turned toward the sunrise to Beth Dagon, and reached to Zebulun, and to the valley of Iphtah El northward to Beth Emek and Neiel. It went out to Cabul on the left hand,
verses.en_bbe: Turning to the east to Beth-dagon and stretching to Zebulun and the valley of Iphtah-el as far as Beth-emek and Neiel to the north; on the left it goes as far as Cabul

verses.en: And Hebron, and Rehob, and Hammon, and Kanah, even unto great Zidon;
verses.pt: E engloba a Hebrom, e Reobe, e Hamom, e Caná, até a grande Sidom;
verses.en_web: and Ebron, Rehob, Hammon, and Kanah, even to great Sidon.
verses.en_bbe: And Ebron and Rehob and Hammon and Kanah, to great Zidon;

verses.en: And then the coast turneth to Ramah, and to the strong city Tyre; and the coast turneth to Hosah; and the outgoings thereof are at the sea from the coast to Achzib:
verses.pt: E torna dali este termo a Hormá, e até a forte cidade de Tiro, e torna este termo a Hosa, e sai ao mar desde o território de Aczibe:
verses.en_web: The border turned to Ramah, to the fortified city of Tyre; and the border turned to Hosah. It ended at the sea by the region of Achzib;
verses.en_bbe: And the limit goes round to Ramah and the walled town of Tyre and Hosah, ending at the sea by Heleb and Achzib;

verses.en: Ummah also, and Aphek, and Rehob: twenty and two cities with their villages.
verses.pt: Engloba também Umá, e Afeque, e Reobe: vinte e duas cidades com suas aldeias.
verses.en_web: Ummah also, and Aphek, and Rehob: twenty-two cities with their villages.
verses.en_bbe: And Ummah and Aphek and Rehob; twenty-two towns with their unwalled places.

verses.en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families, these cities with their villages.
verses.pt: Esta é a herança da tribo dos filhos de Aser por suas famílias; estas cidades com suas aldeias.
verses.en_web: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families, these cities with their villages.
verses.en_bbe: This is the heritage of the tribe of the children of Asher by their families, these towns with their unwalled places.

verses.en: The sixth lot came out to the children of Naphtali, even for the children of Naphtali according to their families.
verses.pt: A sexta porção saiu para os filhos de Naftali, pelos filhos de Naftali conforme suas famílias.
verses.en_web: The sixth lot came out for the children of Naphtali, even for the children of Naphtali according to their families.
verses.en_bbe: For the children of Naphtali the sixth heritage came out, for the children of Naphtali by their families;

verses.en: And their coast was from Heleph, from Allon to Zaanannim, and Adami, Nekeb, and Jabneel, unto Lakum; and the outgoings thereof were at Jordan:
verses.pt: E foi seu termo desde Helefe, e Alom-Zaanim, e Adami-Neguebe, e Jabneel, até Lacum; e sai ao Jordão;
verses.en_web: Their border was from Heleph, from the oak in Zaanannim, Adami-nekeb, and Jabneel, to Lakkum. It ended at the Jordan.
verses.en_bbe: And their limit was from Heleph, from the oak-tree in Zaanannim, and Adami-hannekeb and Jabneel, as far as Lakkum, ending at Jordan;

verses.en: And then the coast turneth westward to Aznoth-tabor, and goeth out from thence to Hukkok, and reacheth to Zebulun on the south side, and reacheth to Asher on the west side, and to Judah upon Jordan toward the sunrising.
verses.pt: E tornando dali este termo até o ocidente a Aznote-Tabor, passa dali a Hucoque, e chega até Zebulom ao sul, e ao ocidente confina com Aser, e com Judá ao Jordão até o oriente.
verses.en_web: The border turned westward to Aznoth Tabor, and went out from there to Hukkok. It reached to Zebulun on the south, and reached to Asher on the west, and to Judah at the Jordan toward the sunrise.
verses.en_bbe: And turning west to Aznoth-tabor, the limit goes out from there to Hukkok, stretching to Zebulun on the south, and Asher on the west, and Judah at Jordan on the east.

verses.en: And the fenced cities are Ziddim, Zer, and Hammath, Rakkath, and Chinnereth,
verses.pt: E as cidades fortes são Zidim, Zer, e Hamate, Racate, e Quinerete,
verses.en_web: The fortified cities were Ziddim, Zer, Hammath, Rakkath, Chinnereth,
verses.en_bbe: And the walled towns are Ziddim, Zer, and Hammath, Rakkath, and Chinnereth

verses.en: And Adamah, and Ramah, and Hazor,
verses.pt: E Adama, e Ramá, e Hazor,
verses.en_web: Adamah, Ramah, Hazor,
verses.en_bbe: And Adamah and Ramah and Hazor

verses.en: And Kedesh, and Edrei, and En-hazor,
verses.pt: E Quedes, e Edrei, e En-Hazor,
verses.en_web: Kedesh, Edrei, En Hazor,
verses.en_bbe: And Kedesh and Edrei and En-Hazor

verses.en: And Iron, and Migdal-el, Horem, and Beth-anath, and Beth-shemesh; nineteen cities with their villages.
verses.pt: E Irom, e Migdal-Ele, e Horém, e Bete-Anate, e Bete-Semes: dezenove cidades com suas aldeias.
verses.en_web: Iron, Migdal El, Horem, Beth Anath, and Beth Shemesh; nineteen cities with their villages.
verses.en_bbe: And Iron and Migdal-el, Horem and Beth-anath and Beth-shemesh; nineteen towns with their unwalled places.

verses.en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Naphtali according to their families, the cities and their villages.
verses.pt: Esta é a herança da tribo dos filhos de Naftali por suas famílias; estas cidades com suas aldeias.
verses.en_web: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Naphtali according to their families, the cities with their villages.
verses.en_bbe: This is the heritage of the tribe of the children of Naphtali by their families, these towns with their unwalled places.

verses.en: And the seventh lot came out for the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families.
verses.pt: A sétima porção saiu para a tribo dos filhos de Dã por suas famílias.
verses.en_web: The seventh lot came out for the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families.
verses.en_bbe: For the tribe of Dan by their families the seventh heritage came out;

verses.en: And the coast of their inheritance was Zorah, and Eshtaol, and Ir-shemesh,
verses.pt: E foi o termo de sua herança, Zorá, e Estaol, e Ir-Semes,
verses.en_web: The border of their inheritance was Zorah, Eshtaol, Irshemesh,
verses.en_bbe: And the limit of their heritage was Zorah and Eshtaol and Ir-shemesh

verses.en: And Shaalabbin, and Ajalon, and Jethlah,
verses.pt: E Saalabim, e Aijalom, e Itla,
verses.en_web: Shaalabbin, Aijalon, Ithlah,
verses.en_bbe: And Shaalabbin and Aijalon and Ithlah

verses.en: And Elon, and Thimnathah, and Ekron,
verses.pt: E Elom, e Timna, e Ecrom,
verses.en_web: Elon, Timnah, Ekron,
verses.en_bbe: And Elon and Timnah and Ekron

verses.en: And Eltekeh, and Gibbethon, and Baalath,
verses.pt: E Elteque, Gibetom, e Baalate,
verses.en_web: Eltekeh, Gibbethon, Baalath,
verses.en_bbe: And Eltekeh and Gibbethon and Baalath

verses.en: And Jehud, and Bene-berak, and Gath-rimmon,
verses.pt: E Jeúde, e Bene-Beraque, e Gate-Rimom,
verses.en_web: Jehud, Bene Berak, Gath Rimmon,
verses.en_bbe: And Jehud and Bene-berak and Gath-rimmon;

verses.en: And Me-jarkon, and Rakkon, with the border before Japho.
verses.pt: E Me-Jarcom, e Racom, com o termo que está diante de Jope.
verses.en_web: Me Jarkon, and Rakkon, with the border over against Joppa.
verses.en_bbe: And on the west was ... opposite Joppa.

verses.en: And the coast of the children of Dan went out too little for them: therefore the children of Dan went up to fight against Leshem, and took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and possessed it, and dwelt therein, and called Leshem, Dan, after the name of Dan their father.
verses.pt: E faltou-lhes termo aos filhos de Dã; e subiram os filhos de Dã e combateram a Lesém, e tomando-a feriram-na a fio de espada, e a possuíram, e habitaram nela; e chamaram a Lesém, Dã, do nome de Dã seu pai.
verses.en_web: The border of the children of Dan went out beyond them; for the children of Dan went up and fought against Leshem, and took it, and struck it with the edge of the sword, and possessed it, and lived therein, and called Leshem, Dan, after the name of Dan their forefather.
verses.en_bbe: (But the limit of the children of Dan was not wide enough for them; so the children of Dan went up and made war on Leshem and took it, putting it to the sword without mercy, and they took it for their heritage and made a place for themselves there, giving it the name of Leshem-dan, after the name of their father, Dan.)

verses.en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families, these cities with their villages.
verses.pt: Esta é a herança da tribo dos filhos de Dã conforme suas famílias; estas cidades com suas aldeias.
verses.en_web: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families, these cities with their villages.
verses.en_bbe: This is the heritage of the tribe of the children of Dan by their families, these towns with their unwalled places.

verses.en: When they had made an end of dividing the land for inheritance by their coasts, the children of Israel gave an inheritance to Joshua the son of Nun among them:
verses.pt: E depois que acabaram de repartir a terra em herança por seus termos, deram os filhos de Israel herança a Josué filho de Num em meio deles:
verses.en_web: So they finished distributing the land for inheritance by its borders. The children of Israel gave an inheritance to Joshua the son of Nun among them.
verses.en_bbe: So the distribution of the land and its limits was complete; and the children of Israel gave Joshua, the son of Nun, a heritage among them;

verses.en: According to the word of the LORD they gave him the city which he asked, even Timnath-serah in mount Ephraim: and he built the city, and dwelt therein.
verses.pt: Segundo a palavra do SENHOR, lhe deram a cidade que ele pediu, Timnate-Heres, no monte de Efraim; e ele reedificou a cidade, e habitou nela.
verses.en_web: According to Yahweh’s commandment, they gave him the city which he asked, even Timnathserah in the hill country of Ephraim; and he built the city, and lived there.
verses.en_bbe: By the orders of the Lord they gave him the town for which he made request, Timnath-serah in the hill-country of Ephraim: there, after building the town, he made his living-place.

verses.en: These are the inheritances which Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel, divided for an inheritance by lot in Shiloh before the LORD, at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation. So they made an end of dividing the country.
verses.pt: Estas são as propriedades que Eleazar sacerdote, e Josué filho de Num, e os principais dos pais, entregaram por sorte em possessão às tribos dos filhos de Israel em Siló diante do SENHOR, à entrada do tabernáculo do testemunho; e acabaram de repartir a terra.
verses.en_web: These are the inheritances, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers’ houses of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed for inheritance by lot in Shiloh before Yahweh, at the door of the Tent of Meeting. So they finished dividing the land.
verses.en_bbe: These are the heritages which Eleazar the priest and Joshua, the son of Nun, and the heads of families of the tribes of the children of Israel gave out at Shiloh, by the decision of the Lord, at the door of the Tent of meeting. So the distribution of the land was complete.
